name: Тренажер тактики: мікс
description:
In this lesson you will train a lot of different chess tricks (tactics). The puzzles in this lesson are taken from a large number of previous lessons. Just like in a real game, you have to decide which tactics to use. Sometimes the best move is easy to find and sometimes you have to come up with a tricky combination. Don't move too fast, and take time to think!

If you want to practise a bit before trying, repeat the lesson(s) that you find difficult.

Start right away? Click on Play now. Good luck!

texts: Collect as many points as possible. Consider an in-between check!
